lessons.title: release-lane: InputBatch required field missing on AscendInputBatch (v0.28.0)
lessons.symptom: PR #16296: main-lane CI green, 7 release-matrix jobs failed with TypeError: __init__() missing 1 required positional argument: 'max_seq_len_np' at AscendInputBatch construction in vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py.  v0.28.0's InputBatch requires max_seq_len_np; the vllm-ascend subclass constructor did not pass it.  PR CI runs mypy/cpu-ut on the main pin only — the release leg has e2e only, so the drift surfaced only in the release e2e matrix after push.
lessons.root_cause: Dataclass contract drift between the pinned release vllm tree (v0.28.0) and main: a field required on one tree is absent (or optional) on the other.  No release-lane static validation existed in the flow — pre_ci/final gate validated only the main vllm tree, and the fix rounds had no pattern for dual-version dataclass fields, so a constructor kwargs-dict rewrite was the natural but wrong move (it breaks AST structure tests).
fix_guidance: The pattern that passes ALL axes (main mypy, release mypy, main runtime, release runtime, AST structure tests) with NO version guard: the vllm-ascend SUBCLASS owns the compat field as field(default=None, kw_only=True) — a plain defaulted field dies at import time on the release tree with TypeError: non-default argument '<earlier field>' follows default argument — and EVERY construction site passes it by name, unconditionally: AscendInputBatch(..., max_seq_len_np=max_num_batched_tokens, ...).
Own the field AND pass the value: owning it without passing = the release runtime silently constructs with None — latent wrong behavior that survives pre_ci and smoke e2e.
REJECTED: plain subclass default 'x: T | None = None' — release tree dies at IMPORT (TypeError: non-default argument ... follows default argument).
REJECTED: inline '**({...} if vllm_version_is(...) else {...})' at the call site — main-tree mypy rejects the conditional kwargs spread.

REJECTED: moving constructor args into a runtime-built kwargs dict — AST structure tests (tests/ut/worker/test_model_runner_v2_mamba.py) require keywords['num_reqs_after_padding'] to be an ast.Name; a dict lookup fails as a message-less KeyError.

Drift direction is symmetric — never assume 'release added it' or 'main removed it'.  When you see this TypeError shape, diff the base dataclass between BOTH trees; there is never just one drifted field.
lessons.example:
class AscendInputBatch(InputBatch):
    max_seq_len_np: np.ndarray | None = field(default=None, kw_only=True)

# call site — unconditional and named, BOTH trees:
batch = AscendInputBatch(..., max_seq_len_np=max_num_batched_tokens, ...)
